title: iceberg-cpp 0.4.0 release
summary: Manu Zhang proposed starting the iceberg-cpp 0.4.0 release and volunteered as release manager with support from Gang Wu. Since 0.3.0 in June, 174 commits had landed, covering Iceberg v3 types, column default values, deletion vectors and row lineage, table update operations such as MergeAppend and RowDelta, parallel manifest reads and writes, REST SigV4 and OAuth2 token exchange, an initial Hive Metastore client, and removal of Meson build support. Variant types, encryption and Puffin statistics were deferred. Gang Wu saw no blockers and noted the Arrow C++ variant PR would take a while. Junwang Zhao asked to postpone to late October to include CherryPickOperation and RewriteManifests; Manu preferred faster, smaller releases with another one in late October, and Junwang agreed. A tracking issue (apache/iceberg-cpp#955) was created for the release.

positions.stance: Start the 0.4.0 release now and defer variant, encryption and Puffin statistics to a later release.
No blockers; variant can move to 0.5.0 because the Arrow C++ variant PR will take a while to merge.
Asked to postpone to late October so CherryPickOperation and RewriteManifests could be included.
Prefers faster, smaller releases for early user feedback, with another release in late October for the remaining features.

outcome.note: The request to postpone was dropped and the 0.4.0 release went ahead with Manu Zhang as release manager; a tracking issue (apache/iceberg-cpp#955) was created.

why_it_matters: iceberg-cpp 0.4.0 carries v3 support, while variant, encryption, CherryPickOperation and RewriteManifests wait for a later release.
